purpose: Original41-tape seed/enumerate/cleanup program;zero-row case only. Starts with marked empty dimension word,arbitrary old output prefix,and39blank work tapes. Checks halt,all41heads,exact dimension word and old output prefix,and blankness of every work cell. No positive-N execution claimed.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.SeededEnumerationResources

open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def enumIdentityMap : RationalMobius where
  a:=1; b:=0; c:=0; d:=1; lo:=0; hi:=1
  interval_nonempty:=by norm_num
  determinant_pos:=by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos:=by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos:=by norm_num

def enumSourcePorts : List SourceEndpoints.Port :=
  ([EndpointClip.Port.dimension,.index,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.grid]++
    (List.finRange 4).map EndpointClip.Port.work++(List.finRange 3).map EndpointClip.Port.out).map
      SourceEndpoints.Port.shared++(List.finRange 3).map SourceEndpoints.Port.other

def enumImagePorts : List SourceImages.Port := enumSourcePorts.map SourceImages.Port.source++
  (List.finRange 3).map SourceImages.Port.work++
  (List.finRange 4).flatMap (fun j => [SourceImages.Port.out j false,SourceImages.Port.out j true])
def enumPrepPorts : List RowPreparation.Port := enumImagePorts.map RowPreparation.Port.images++
  (List.finRange 4).map RowPreparation.Port.threshold++(List.finRange 4).map RowPreparation.Port.crossing++[.temp]
def enumRowPorts : List RowExecution.Port := enumPrepPorts.map RowExecution.Port.prep++[.counter,.stream]
def enumPorts : List RecordedRow.Port := enumRowPorts.map RecordedRow.Port.row++[.output]
def enumHeads (p : RecordedRow.Port) : Int := if p=.output then 101 else -19

def markedExact (w : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (w.left.headD .blank=.start) && w.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (w.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (w.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))


def seededPorts : List SeededEnumeration.Port := enumPorts.map SeededEnumeration.Port.rows++[.source]
def seededHeads (p : SeededEnumeration.Port) : Int := if p=.rows .output then 103 else -23

def seededEmptyCheck : Bool :=
  let F:=enumIdentityMap
  let source : List Bool:=[]
  let pre : List (Sym Bool):=[.data true,.data false,.start]
  let bank:=SeededEnumeration.initial source pre
  let c : NativeZipper.Config SeededEnumeration.Port (SeededEnumeration.Label F):=
    ⟨⟨SeededEnumeration.start F,bank⟩,seededHeads⟩
  let result:=NativeZipper.run (SeededEnumeration.program F) (SeededEnumeration.budget F source) c
  decide (result.core.pc=.done) && decide (seededPorts.length=41) && seededPorts.all (fun p =>
    decide (result.pos p=seededHeads p) &&
    match p with
    | .source => markedExact (result.core.tapes p) source
    | .rows .output => decide (result.core.tapes p=bank p)
    | _ => (result.core.tapes p).left.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
      (result.core.tapes p).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)))

#eval seededEmptyCheck
